verdict.rationale: Sierra is presented purely as a closed commercial SaaS platform (Agent SDK, Studio, Ghostwriter, Voice, etc.) with no evidence of an open-source license for the product itself; the only open artifact found is the unrelated tau-bench research benchmark repo, not Sierra's product source code, and docs/API surfaces are login-gated or 404. Missing for 10: any open-license repository for Sierra's actual product code, license file, or public source release.
